title: advisory lock: pin and document the per-holder wait deadline (DEC-282 (a9) item 2)
description: Twin of the quest-cli follow-up filed under DEC-282 (a9) item 2 (opum-ai/opum-doc#1865, ODOC-610), for the patch after 0.15.1, beside QCLI-571. (a8)'s per-waiter wait (staleAfterMs + 60 s) can expire behind a QUEUE of live holders whose inputs differ and so cannot reuse. The fix named in (a9): a waiter's deadline resets whenever the holder CHANGES, so it expires only against one holder that has held too long. STATE: #746 round 2 (F4) already implements that reset in src/core/advisory-lock.ts (holderSince resets on owner change), so no behaviour change is expected; what is owed is (1) a test that PINS it (a queue of distinct live holders never trips the wait bound, one wedged holder does) with a mutant that removes the reset going red, and (2) softening the module docblock sentence that says expiry is reachable only in a pathological state, since a queue of differing-input waiters still serialises. No dependency on the 0.15.1 bump.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test fails if the per-holder deadline reset is removed: N distinct live holders in sequence do not expire a waiter, one wedged holder does; mutant run and recorded.
The advisory-lock docblock no longer says expiry is reachable only in a pathological state; it states the queue case and the per-holder bound, and cites DEC-282 (a9).
Wording and behaviour stay consistent with the quest-cli twin.
